name: Shadra: Hunger builds on landed swings and decays back to its floor
contract: Shadra carries Hunger (1004200) with a visible stack count. It starts at 1 and never drops below 1. Every landed melee swing adds one stack and refreshes the contact clock; once three seconds pass without a landed hit the meter decays one stack every half second until it reaches the floor of 1.

steps.label: Hunger is visible at its floor of one stack
Hunger climbs while she is landing hits
Hunger decays back down when contact stops
Give the decay time to bottom out
The meter never falls below the floor
